truth-bible-church-hollywood-md.assessment: Truth Bible Church is an independent Baptist Bible church in Hollywood, Maryland (Southern Maryland), planted in 2008 and now led by Dr. Joshua West, who holds a Th.M and a Th.D in systematic theology from Trinity College of the Bible and Theological Seminary. Its statement of faith affirms the inerrancy of Scripture, the Trinity, orthodox Christology (virgin birth, physical resurrection, substitutionary atonement), and salvation by grace alone through faith alone, with believer's baptism by immersion. The church is governed by a plurality of male elders (Dr. Joshua West, Dr. Alden Laird, Dr. Dennis Richardson, and Dan Ensminger), with no women in pastoral or elder roles and distinct Men of Truth and Women of Truth ministries, which places it clearly in complementarian practice; discipleship runs through Home Groups and one-to-one counseling, and missions are pursued both locally and through Pastor West's work with the church-planting ministry Compel International. The clearest signal comes from West's own published theology: Hard Sayings: Reconciling the Cost of Discipleship and the American Dream and Come and Die press a costly, counter-consumerist discipleship and openly reject the feel-good preaching that never calls sinners to repentance, while The Power of Preaching and his verse-by-verse Romans volumes point to expository, doctrinally serious preaching. The church website (Wix) is sparse and was mid-transition, but the leadership page, an active Facebook (TBCMaryland) and Instagram presence, and the pastor's substantial public writing together substantiate a green rating rather than a default yellow.

score_notes.soteriology: Green — Salvation by grace alone through faith alone in Christ alone; West's Simple Gospel and Come and Die press genuine repentance and reject easy-believism.
score_notes.gender: Green — Governed by a plurality of male elders only, with no women in pastoral or elder roles; distinct Men of Truth and Women of Truth ministries; complementarian in practice (independent Baptist).
score_notes.leadership: Green — Elder-led with a qualified plural eldership: Dr. Joshua West (Lead Pastor), Dr. Alden Laird (Executive Pastor), Dr. Dennis Richardson, and Dan Ensminger.
score_notes.preaching: Green — Expository and conversionist: West authored The Power of Preaching and verse-by-verse Romans volumes, and publicly rejects 'smooth, encouraging messages that make people feel good' in favor of the full counsel of God's word.
score_notes.mission: Green — Local missions ministry plus Pastor West's work with Compel International, planting churches among the unreached and strengthening the persecuted church.
score_notes.cultural: Green — Explicitly counter-consumerist and anti-prosperity-gospel: West's Hard Sayings reconciles 'the Cost of Discipleship and the American Dream,' and Come and Die calls believers to die to self.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Green — 'Men of Truth' men's ministry alongside Home Groups and one-to-one discipleship and counseling.
score_notes.denominational: Green — Independent (no denominational home), but the pastor is answerable to a four-member plural eldership, with an external tie to the Compel International church-planting network.
